rejection_summary: Child 1 first rejected an absence assertion covering a truncated page. Its revised candidate narrowed that scope and passed I1; I2 then rejected a claimed original-model parameter total unsupported by a visible finite architecture. These were different candidates.

Child 2 first rejected paper-wide absence assertions. After additional reads, its revised candidate still claimed an inspected continuous page range despite a truncated page 6. Rejection means the asserted scope was unsupported, not that an unseen page is known to contain a counterexample.

Child 3 had one fully observed empty final response, used the configured bounded author recovery, and then exhausted its original protocol allowance on two invalid JSON responses. No candidate or whole review was produced.

issues.finding: At this delegation time, the actual visible Fourier pages 1–4 and the beginning of page5 did not specify finite experimental layer widths or total parameters. Infinite-width NTK theory does not establish a finite reported model count. This absence of support does not prove that the actual original models used 256 or fewer parameters.

The report names pages2–8 as the range of negative observations but Fourier page6 was visible only for356 of4099 characters; pages2–5 and7–8 were complete. The claim should identify the received excerpt range, or the author can omit the unnecessary negative claim. No contrary result in the unread page6 is asserted by this offline review.

independent_review.summary: Core source mechanisms and the candidate arithmetic of 242 and 256 allocated parameters have support. Acceptance was blocked by an originally unsupported finite-model count and an imprecisely bounded negative observation. Later page8 evidence was not backfilled into the first candidate.

visible_coverage.finding: The source receipt index lists visible page numbers without separating complete extracted text from partial pages. extract_pdf keeps extracted_pages after the character budget is consumed. The full actual observations still retain visible_pages and truncated flags.
visible_coverage.claim_boundary: The author context was updated; the error is not evidence of lost observations. Complete extracted text is also not proof that figures or equations were understood.

cross_agent_cache.finding: Cache lookup is confined to run_root/agent/research/downloads. Main idea did not discover complete hash-verified PDFs already in idea_research/research/downloads, and performed two unsuccessful downloads.
